Name: Better Quarries
Author: Bennoloth
Description:
This mod improves the output of the Mountain, Hilltop, and Four Corners quarries to levels which make it worthwhile to keep some space free for the nodes to spawn, instead of just filling it with Kegs or tapped trees. It is very little at Mining Level 1, and improves over time to eventually include endgame ores/nodes at Mining Level 9-10.

+

Works with 1.6, adding additional spawns of the new Coal node.

The zip file contains three folders - just move all of them to your Mods folder, unless you have a custom farm map where you don't want one of them.

+

Branched from Theoddon's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21482]Balanced Quarry[/url] which has conditions for Cinder Shard and Radioactive Nodes and different spawn rates. My spawn rates are as follows:
